title: Specialized Large Language Models for Markovian Reasoning: Structural Cache Compression, Transition Pretraining, and Dual-Loop Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.28285v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Standard autoregressive large language models attend to the growing history of generated tokens, making the key-value (KV) cache a central memory and throughput bottleneck in long-chain reasoning and multi-branch sampling. Yet an important class of reasoning problems is naturally first-order Markovian: the next step depends on a sufficient representation of the current state, rather than on the raw sequence of all earlier steps. We develop a unified design paradigm for Markovian-reasoning specialized large language models. At the cache level, the Markovian state interface transforms history-dependent KV storage into constant-size state transfer with respect to the number of reasoning steps. At the learning level, we reformulate long-chain prediction as independently trainable one-step transition objectives, with explicit state bottlenecks, distillation, invariance, and drift-consistency losses. translated_title: 面向马尔可夫推理的专用大语言模型：结构化缓存压缩、转移预训练与双循环Transformer
translated_abstract: 标准自回归大语言模型会关注不断增长的已生成token历史，这使得键值（KV）缓存成为长链推理和多分支采样中的核心内存与吞吐量瓶颈。然而，一类重要的推理问题天然具有一阶马尔可夫性质：下一步仅依赖于对当前状态的充分表示，而非所有先前步骤的原始序列。我们为马尔可夫推理专用大语言模型建立了一个统一的设计范式。在缓存层面，马尔可夫状态接口将与历史相关的KV存储转变为相对于推理步数保持常数大小的状态传递。在学习层面，我们将长链预测重新表述为可独立训练的单步转移目标，并引入显式的状态瓶颈、蒸馏、不变性以及漂移一致性损失。在架构层面，我们引入了一种……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出面向马尔可夫推理任务的专用大语言模型统一设计范式，通过常数大小的马尔可夫状态接口实现KV缓存的结构化压缩、将长链预测重构为可独立训练的单步转移预训练目标，并引入双循环Transformer架构，以突破长链推理中的内存与吞吐量瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified design paradigm for Markovian-reasoning-specialized large language models, featuring constant-size Markovian state interfaces for structural KV cache compression, independently trainable one-step transition pretraining objectives, and dual-loop transformer architectures to overcome memory and throughput bottlenecks in long-chain reasoning.
